question: How much higher the average intrinsic value is for trades using the feeling-lucky strategy compared to those using the momentum strategy under long-side trades?
sql:
SELECT 
  AVG(CASE WHEN TargetCompID LIKE '%LUCKY%' THEN StrikePrice END) as feeling_lucky_avg,
  AVG(CASE WHEN TargetCompID LIKE '%MOMO%' THEN StrikePrice END) as momentum_avg,
  AVG(CASE WHEN TargetCompID LIKE '%LUCKY%' THEN StrikePrice END) - AVG(CASE WHEN TargetCompID LIKE '%MOMO%' THEN StrikePrice END) as difference
FROM `bigquery-public-data.cymbal_investments.trade_capture_report`, UNNEST(Sides) s
WHERE s.Side = 'LONG'
